_doc: The swamp ground's woods (bead bzc.126, docs/art/classes/trees.md): swamp willows, bald cypresses hung with moss and mangroves on stilt roots. generate-image-v2 at 48 x 48 like set trees (one call returns many candidates of a mixed subject); the best distinct ones are accepted and cropped to their opaque box plus 1 px. Never scaled, never mirrored. Moss hangs in a few thick strands, never a thin fringe (it turns to noise in a crowd). Layers: style, light, class-tree, subject. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.subject: Subject: one small swamp tree, chunky and cute, each image a different one of these: a squat swamp willow with a big rounded drooping crown of dull olive-green leaf clumps #6b7f3c (shadow #43552a, light #91a556 on the left side) hanging down in a few thick rounded lobes; a bald cypress with a dense flat-topped crown of dark moss green #4a6436 on a flared buttressed brown trunk #5c4630, two or three thick strands of grey-green moss #93a07a hanging from its branches; a gnarled swamp oak with a round dark olive crown draped with a few thick clumps of grey-green moss. A short thick trunk. A full crown about two thirds of the image wide and nearly the full image tall.
recipes.negative: face, eyes, person, ground, water, puddle, grass, reeds, pot, thin hanging threads, bare branches, flowers
